test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All tigers are lions.

All lions are animals.

**Conclusions:**

Ⅰ. All tigers are animals.

Ⅱ. No tigers is a bird.

options.text: Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27ec45f77c203a356f2b809ed961584a2a9181f53eef8aa48d215ae43f26bf7b.png] 

Conclusions:

Ⅰ. All tigers are animals. → **Follows** (As, All tigers are lions and All lions are animals)

Ⅱ. No tigers is a bird. → Do not follow (As, bird is not given in the statement, the relation between bird and tiger cannot be determined)

Hence, **o****nly conclusion I follow**s.

5e:T
